card.name: Verbs just before a you/me object
card.fires_on: Verbs, prepositions or question words in direct-address text where the next word is likely a pronoun like you, me, them or him. Seen in questions and second-person statements.

modes.label: Question openers
modes.description: A question word or modal at the start of a question, before a pronoun or subject.
modes.example: What is a CMS and how<< can>> it be used?

modes.label: Verb or preposition before pronoun
modes.description: A verb or preposition that is followed by you or me as its object.
modes.example: Expect the same of me as I<< expect>> of you.

modes.label: Warning-style verbs
modes.description: A verb in consumer text that leads to an object pronoun such as you or them.
